editorial:
If you want a loud, action-packed animated zombie movie, this one delivers. Chris Redfield teams up with Leon Kennedy and Rebecca Chambers to stop a revenge-driven villain from unleashing a nasty new virus on New York. The story moves fast, the fights are big, and the animation looks sharp enough to keep you locked in. It feels like a video game cutscene stretched into a full movie, which is exactly the point for fans of the series. Even if you only know the live-action films, the characters are easy to follow and the stakes are clear from the start.

The action is the main draw, with gunfights, martial arts, and monster battles that rarely slow down. The voice acting is solid, and the pacing keeps the energy high, though the plot can feel thin and some dialogue is cheesy. If you enjoy nonstop chaos, you will have a good time; if you want deep drama, this may not be your pick. It is best enjoyed as a fun, over-the-top ride. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: By the final act, Chris, Leon, and Rebecca track the villain to New York and fight through infected crowds to stop the virus release. The big twist is that the enemy’s plan is tied to personal revenge, not just chaos, and the heroes must destroy the source before the city falls. They win after a brutal final battle, but the ending leaves room for more danger, reminding you that the Resident Evil world never stays safe for long.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves video game action and zombie movies.
